title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
abstract: arXiv:2610.31670v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. translated_title: 感知运动对齐：具身策略成功的柏拉图式代理指标
translated_abstract: 机器人基础模型通常需要通过代价高昂的闭环回放（rollout）来评估，这促使人们寻找低成本的离线模型能力代理指标。柏拉图表征假说（PRH）指出，随着表征质量的提升，视觉、语言等不同模态会收敛到对现实的共享统计模型。我们提出一个问题：运动轨迹是否构成另一种这样的模态——当具身模型能力增强时，其感知表征是否应向物理运动的结构收敛？为探究这一点，我们提出了感知运动对齐，这是一种无需训练的离线指标，用于衡量模型的感知表征与物理运动几何结构的对齐程度。我们发现，S² 在多个具身模型家族中均与下游机器人任务成功率呈正相关，因此可作为低成本的离线代理指标，在闭环评估之前对模型进行优先级排序。S² 还能够识别出有前景的（模型）（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出无需训练的离线指标“感知运动对齐”（S²），通过衡量模型感知表征与物理运动几何结构的对齐程度，低成本地预测具身模型的下游任务成功率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Sensorimotor Alignment (S²), a training-free offline metric measuring how well a model's sensory representations align with the geometry of physical motion, which correlates with downstream robot task success and serves as a cheap proxy for model ranking before costly closed-loop evaluation.
